worldNews.headline: Palantir stock jumps 29% after an "otherworldly" AI-driven quarter
worldNews.why: US commercial revenue grew 149% year-over-year and the company raised full-year guidance to $8.16B, underscoring how strong AI-sovereignty demand is fueling the broader market rally.

worldNews.headline: Musk says SpaceX will build exclusively on Nvidia's next-gen Vera Rubin chips
worldNews.why: On SpaceX's first earnings call as a public company, Musk committed to Nvidia hardware for its orbital AI data centers — a major vote of confidence that sent Nvidia shares higher.

worldNews.headline: Iran and Oman make progress on a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
worldNews.why: A workable shipping-lane agreement could ease the Middle East crisis and oil-supply risk; Brent crude has already dipped on the news, with US officials suggesting a deal could land within days.

worldNews.headline: Fighting breaks out in western Tigray, threatening Ethiopia's peace deal
worldNews.why: The clashes are among the most serious breaches yet of the three-year-old ceasefire, raising the risk of a renewed large-scale conflict in the Horn of Africa.

worldNews.headline: Ukraine's Patriot interceptor shortage is leaving its skies exposed
worldNews.why: Production of PAC-3 missiles can't keep pace with consumption, and recent Russian strikes went entirely unintercepted — a critical capability gap with direct humanitarian stakes.

worldNews.headline: Arson suspect arrested over deadly Spokane wildfires
worldNews.why: The fires destroyed hundreds of homes and displaced roughly 67,000 people — one of the largest US urban wildfire displacements in recent memory.

worldNews.headline: Goldman Sachs deepens its bet on "Y'all Street" with a $700M Dallas campus
worldNews.why: The move reflects a broader migration of financial-sector jobs from high-cost hubs like New York toward lower-cost cities such as Dallas — a notable regional economic shift.

worldNews.headline: US margin debt hits a fresh record high
worldNews.why: Investor borrowing is growing far faster than the market itself — a leverage pattern that has preceded past downturns, even though it isn't a guaranteed crash signal.

worldNews.headline: Wall Street closes at record highs as the AI-driven rally broadens
worldNews.why: The Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all posted record closes, with over 84% of reporting S&P 500 companies beating earnings estimates — a sign of broad-based, not just AI-sector, strength.

worldNews.headline: Kospi and Nikkei surge as the AI/semiconductor rally spreads across Asia
worldNews.why: South Korea's Kospi jumped over 4.5% and Japan's Nikkei gained more than 2.6%, showing the AI infrastructure boom is a global market driver, not a US-only phenomenon.

worldNews.headline: Rwanda's drone healthcare program gets a US grant even as other US aid is cut
worldNews.why: The Trump administration is funding Zipline's medical-drone deliveries while simultaneously cutting ~$200M in broader aid to Rwanda — illustrating a shift toward tech-vendor-led foreign assistance.

aiSales.headline: Conversation intelligence is moving from post-call review to real-time in-call guidance
aiSales.takeaway: Tools like Gong and Chorus now claim ~84% predictive accuracy for deal outcomes. Consider piloting live call guidance on your highest-value deals to catch risk signals before they cost the deal, not after.

aiSales.headline: Standalone conversation-intelligence tools are merging into unified enablement platforms
aiSales.takeaway: Buyers increasingly want one system instead of stitched-together point solutions. When evaluating vendors, weigh their consolidation roadmap — a unified platform can cut tool sprawl and boost rep adoption.

aiSales.headline: AI roleplay and skill-practice tools are going mainstream
aiSales.takeaway: Platforms like Hyperbound and Second Nature let reps rehearse pitches against an AI buyer. Use this for onboarding and new-messaging rollouts so reps get repetitions before live calls, cutting ramp time.

aiSales.headline: AI enablement is shifting from 'recommend' to 'execute'
aiSales.takeaway: Leading platforms now auto-update CRM records and draft follow-ups instead of just suggesting them. Audit your stack for rote admin work AI could take over, freeing your time for coaching design instead of busywork support.

aiSales.headline: Half of sales professionals say AI now enables scale that wasn't possible before
aiSales.takeaway: A useful data point for building the internal business case for enablement AI budget — pair it with a concrete pilot result from your own team for maximum impact.
